enabled.name: Enable 3D Audio
enabled.hint: Apply listener-relative HRTF spatialization to enabled canvas Ambient Sounds and door sounds. Disabling this restores native playback.

doorsEnabled.name: Enable 3D Door Sounds
doorsEnabled.hint: Use the door audio controls in wall configuration. Disable to restore Foundry's native door sounds for every door, without affecting Ambient Sounds.

door.title: 3D Door Sounds
door.hint: Uses the Door Sound preset selected above, including registered custom presets. Both 3D Audio world settings must be enabled; without a controlled token, playback is native.

enabled.label: Enable 3D Audio
enabled.hint: Disable to use Foundry's native door audio for this door.

radius.label: Hearing radius
radius.hint: Maximum hearing distance in scene units, including for controlled GM tokens. Defaults to Foundry's native door radius of twelve grid distances.

volume.label: Volume
volume.hint: Sound volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (full volume), before native distance attenuation.

easing.label: Distance easing
easing.hint: Fade with distance, like Ambient Sounds. When disabled, volume stays constant inside the hearing radius.

walls.label: Blocked by walls
walls.hint: Sound-blocking walls prevent hearing. When disabled, Foundry applies its native muffling instead of blocking the sound.
